rules.title: Safety Interlock Priority Inversion
rules.description: Emergency Stop EXTI line must have Preemption Priority 0 (highest in NVIC). No peripheral or timer interrupt can preempt the safety line.
rules.reference: IEC 60204-1 Clause 9.2.5.4, ARM Cortex-M4 NVIC Architecture

rules.title: Blocking Delay Inside Interrupt Handler
rules.description: Calling HAL_Delay() inside an ISR causes an infinite loop/deadlock if the calling ISR priority is higher than or equal to SysTick priority.

rules.title: Missing volatile on Shared DMA/ISR Memory
rules.description: Any variable or buffer updated by DMA hardware or an ISR and read by the main execution loop must be qualified with volatile.

rules.title: Unserviced Independent Watchdog
rules.description: Firmware must initialize and refresh IWDG timer in main superloop. Missing watchdog leaves the MCU vulnerable to latch-up or deadlock.
